about_the_game:
About the Game

In a harsh and unforgiving world, people dream of something greater—something monumental they hope to reach one day. Some say there’s wealth at the summit. Others speak of a utopia that awaits. But the truth is, no one really knows what lies at the end. 《HollowJump》 is a quiet yet relentless journey upward, chasing the question itself. You fall again and again— and yet, even within the seemingly meaningless repetition, you keep climbing, higher and higher. Toward a destination no one has seen, just one more step—upward.

Game Overview

You are an adventurer in a fantasy steampunk world. Armed with nothing but your ability to jump and dash, you traverse airborne cities, mechanical ruins, and bizarre, living structures inhabited by machine-fused creatures—all in search of the truth. With a dystopian setting, constant tension, tight controls, and a vertically expanding level design, 《HollowJump》 offers more than just a jump game. It’s a deeply immersive experience that quietly reflects on the essence of life itself.

Features

  • A thought-provoking message exploring the meaning of life

  • Striking vertical 2D pixel art maps

  • A fantasy world fused with flying airships, biomechanical lifeforms, and mysterious mechanical civilizations

  • Tense, timing-based gameplay focused on evasion

  • Precision controls with jump strength adjustment, aerial dashes, and rhythmic movement to test your skills

  • Simple at first, but designed to reveal deeper mechanics the higher you climb

  • A narrative told through fragmented world-building and mysterious NPC encounters, waiting for you to piece it together

    A profound journey, unfolding through simple controls.

    Feel the quiet message the world has to offer—firsthand.

short_description: Jump and dash that’s your whole life. In a world of dystopia, fantasy, and steampunk, you run to find truth. Meet people, dodge monsters, and leap between buildings. Simple controls hide a test of patience and purpose. HollowJump — an addictive vertical adventure where philosophy follows every jump
